pages.text: Apply a status effect with a duration, amplifier and display options. The reference slot samples a potion's first effect.

pages.title: Default Aether Cost
pages.text: Timed effects: 20*t*(a+1)^2*k per target. Instant effects use 1K*(a+1)^2*k instead of duration.

pages.title: Structural Complexity
pages.text: 0.1, regardless of damage, effect level or number of targets.
